The purpose of this script is to 1) explore single cell RNA-seq results without considering cell type and 2) analyze for relationships between gene expression and testosterone, progesterone, and estradiol concentrations from developing human brain samples. This script analyzes males and females combined.

# Set Up
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

Packages <- c("tidyverse", "Seurat", "Signac", "glue", "readxl", "cowplot", "edgeR", "limma", "patchwork", "svglite", "Matrix", "ggpubr", "ggpp")

lapply(Packages, library, character.only=TRUE)

set.seed(123)
```

## Remove Outliers
```{r remove outliers}
detect_outliers <- function(data, variable) {
  outlier_limit <- quantile(data[[variable]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.5 * IQR(data[[variable]], na.rm = TRUE)
  data %>% filter(.data[[variable]] <= outlier_limit)
}

targeted_comparison_filtered_TT <- detect_outliers(targeted_comparison_raw, "TT")
targeted_comparison_filtered_E2 <- detect_outliers(targeted_comparison_raw, "E2")
targeted_comparison_filtered_P4 <- detect_outliers(targeted_comparison_raw, "P4")
```


# Pseudobulk
## Metadata and Pseudobulk Functions

```{r metadata and pseudobulk}
prepare_metadata_for_analysis <- function(pb_metadata, targeted_comparison_filtered) {
  targeted_comparison_filtered$Sample <- paste0("tissue", targeted_comparison_filtered$Sample)
  pb_metadata %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("pseudobulk_id") %>%
    left_join(targeted_comparison_filtered %>% select(Sample, Sex, TT, E2, P4, GW),
              by = c("sample_id" = "Sample")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Sex), cell_count >= 10) %>%
    mutate(group = paste(cell_type, Sex, sep = "_")) %>%
    column_to_rownames("pseudobulk_id")
}

pseudobulk_data <- function(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts", sample_col = "sample_id", celltype_col = "cell_type") {
  counts <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = assay, slot = layer)
  meta <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  meta$cell_type <- meta$notype
  group_ids <- interaction(meta[[sample_col]], meta[[celltype_col]], drop = TRUE)
  group_levels <- levels(group_ids)
  aggregated_list <- list()
  metadata_list <- list()
  
  for (gid in group_levels) {
  group_cells <- which(group_ids == gid)
  if (length(group_cells) < 1) next
  group_counts <- Matrix::rowSums(counts[, group_cells, drop = FALSE])
  aggregated_list[[gid]] <- group_counts
    metadata_list[[gid]] <- data.frame(
      sample_id = meta[[sample_col]][group_cells[1]],
      cell_type = meta[[celltype_col]][group_cells[1]],
      cell_count = length(group_cells),
      row.names = gid
    )
  }
  
  pseudobulk_mat <- do.call(rbind, aggregated_list)
  metadata_df <- do.call(rbind, metadata_list)
  
  pseudobulk_mat_log <- log1p(as.matrix(pseudobulk_mat))
  
  list(counts = pseudobulk_mat, logcounts = pseudobulk_mat_log, metadata = metadata_df)
}
```

## Generate and Filter Pseudobulk Data

```{r generate and filter pseudobulk data, warnings = FALSE}

generate_and_filter_pseudobulk <- function(seurat_obj, targeted_filtered) {
  seurat_obj$cell_type <- seurat_obj$notype  # ensure column exists
  seurat_obj$sample_id <- seurat_obj$sample        # ensure column exists
  
  pb <- pseudobulk_data(seurat_obj)
  pb_metadata <- prepare_metadata_for_analysis(pb$metadata, targeted_filtered)
  
  common_ids <- intersect(rownames(pb$logcounts), rownames(pb_metadata))
  pb$logcounts <- pb$logcounts[common_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  pb$counts <- pb$counts[common_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  pb$metadata <- pb_metadata[common_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  
  list(pb = pb, metadata = pb_metadata)
}

notype_pb_TT <- generate_and_filter_pseudobulk(SSD_data_v5, targeted_comparison_filtered_TT)
notypepb_E2 <- generate_and_filter_pseudobulk(SSD_data_v5, targeted_comparison_filtered_E2)
notypepb_P4 <- generate_and_filter_pseudobulk(SSD_data_v5, targeted_comparison_filtered_P4)
```

## Diagnostic Plots: Understanding Pseudobulk Data Structure

```{r diagnostic-plots, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
# Create output directory for diagnostics
dir.create("../../results/targeted/pseudobulk_diagnostics", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Function to create comprehensive diagnostic plots
create_pseudobulk_diagnostics <- function(pb_data, pb_name, hormone_name) {
  
  counts <- pb_data$pb$counts  # samples x genes
  metadata <- pb_data$metadata
  
  # Calculate key metrics
  library_sizes <- rowSums(counts)
  genes_detected_per_sample <- rowSums(counts > 0)
  mean_counts_per_gene <- colMeans(counts)
  
  # Calculate CPM
  cpm_mat <- edgeR::cpm(t(counts), log = FALSE)  # Need genes x samples for cpm
  mean_cpm_per_gene <- rowMeans(cpm_mat)
  
  # Create comprehensive diagnostic plot
  p1 <- ggplot(metadata, aes(x = reorder(rownames(metadata), cell_count), y = cell_count, fill = Sex)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("F" = "#E69F00", "M" = "#56B4E9")) +
    labs(title = paste0("Cell Counts per Pseudobulk Sample (", pb_name, ")"),
         x = "Sample", y = "Number of Cells Aggregated") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))
  
  p2 <- ggplot(data.frame(library_size = library_sizes, 
                          sample = rownames(counts),
                          cell_count = metadata$cell_count,
                          Sex = metadata$Sex), 
               aes(x = cell_count, y = library_size, color = Sex)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("F" = "#E69F00", "M" = "#56B4E9")) +
    scale_y_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(title = "Library Size vs Cell Count",
         x = "Cell Count", y = "Total Counts (log10)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    stat_cor(method = "pearson", label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "top")
  
  p3 <- ggplot(data.frame(genes_detected = genes_detected_per_sample,
                          sample = rownames(counts),
                          cell_count = metadata$cell_count,
                          Sex = metadata$Sex),
               aes(x = cell_count, y = genes_detected, color = Sex)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("F" = "#E69F00", "M" = "#56B4E9")) +
    labs(title = "Genes Detected vs Cell Count",
         x = "Cell Count", y = "Number of Genes with Counts > 0") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    stat_cor(method = "pearson", label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "top")
  
  # Gene-level summaries
  p4 <- ggplot(data.frame(mean_counts = mean_counts_per_gene), 
               aes(x = mean_counts)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 100, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(title = "Distribution of Mean Raw Counts per Gene",
         x = "Mean Raw Counts (log10)", y = "Number of Genes") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(1, 10, 50, 100), linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.5) +
    annotate("text", x = c(1, 10, 50, 100), y = Inf, 
             label = c("1", "10", "50", "100"), vjust = 1.5, size = 3, color = "red")
  
  p5 <- ggplot(data.frame(mean_cpm = mean_cpm_per_gene), 
               aes(x = mean_cpm)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 100, fill = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    labs(title = "Distribution of Mean CPM per Gene",
         x = "Mean CPM (log10)", y = "Number of Genes") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10), linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.5) +
    annotate("text", x = c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10), y = Inf, 
             label = c("0.1", "0.5", "1", "5", "10"), vjust = 1.5, size = 3, color = "red")
  
  # Sample prevalence per gene
  genes_per_sample_count <- rowSums(t(counts) > 0)  # genes x samples for this
  p6 <- ggplot(data.frame(n_samples = genes_per_sample_count),
               aes(x = n_samples)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = max(genes_per_sample_count), fill = "purple", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = "Gene Prevalence Across Samples",
         x = "Number of Samples with Count > 0", y = "Number of Genes") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(3, 5, 10), linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.5) +
    annotate("text", x = c(3, 5, 10), y = Inf,
             label = c("3", "5", "10"), vjust = 1.5, size = 3, color = "red")
  
  # Summary statistics
  summary_text <- paste0(
    "Summary Statistics:\n",
    "- Total samples: ", nrow(counts), "\n",
    "- Total genes: ", ncol(counts), "\n",
    "- Cell count range: ", min(metadata$cell_count), " - ", max(metadata$cell_count), "\n",
    "- Median cells/sample: ", median(metadata$cell_count), "\n",
    "- Library size range: ", scales::comma(min(library_sizes)), " - ", scales::comma(max(library_sizes)), "\n",
    "- Median library size: ", scales::comma(median(library_sizes)), "\n",
    "- Genes detected/sample (median): ", median(genes_detected_per_sample)
  )
  
  p7 <- ggplot() + 
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = summary_text, size = 4, hjust = 0.5) +
    theme_void()
  
  # Filtering impact preview
  filter_thresholds <- data.frame(
    raw_count = c(1, 2, 10, 50, 100),
    cpm = c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 5)
  )
  
  filter_results <- purrr::map_dfr(1:nrow(filter_thresholds), function(i) {
    # Raw count filtering
    genes_raw <- sum(rowSums(t(counts) >= filter_thresholds$raw_count[i]) >= 10)
    # CPM filtering  
    genes_cpm <- sum(rowSums(cpm_mat >= filter_thresholds$cpm[i]) >= 10)
    
    data.frame(
      threshold = paste0("Raw: ", filter_thresholds$raw_count[i], "\nCPM: ", filter_thresholds$cpm[i]),
      raw_count = genes_raw,
      cpm_based = genes_cpm,
      type = c("Raw Count", "CPM")
    )
  })
  
  filter_results_long <- filter_results %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(raw_count, cpm_based), names_to = "filter_type", values_to = "genes_retained")
  
  p8 <- ggplot(filter_results_long, aes(x = threshold, y = genes_retained, fill = filter_type)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("raw_count" = "steelblue", "cpm_based" = "darkgreen"),
                     labels = c("Raw Count", "CPM-based")) +
    labs(title = "Genes Retained with Different Filters\n(Requiring presence in ≥10 samples)",
         x = "Filter Threshold", y = "Number of Genes Retained",
         fill = "Filter Type") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  # Combine all plots
  combined <- (p1 | p2 | p3) / (p4 | p5 | p6) / (p7 | p8)
  
  # Save combined plot
  ggsave(paste0("../../results/targeted/pseudobulk_diagnostics/", pb_name, "_diagnostics.png"),
         plot = combined, width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300)
  
  ggsave(paste0("../../results/targeted/pseudobulk_diagnostics/", pb_name, "_diagnostics.svg"),
         plot = combined, width = 16, height = 12)
  
  # Print summary to console
  cat("\n===========================================\n")
  cat(pb_name, "Pseudobulk Diagnostics\n")
  cat("===========================================\n")
  cat(summary_text, "\n")
  cat("\nRecommended filtering based on data:\n")
  cat("- If using RAW COUNTS: count_threshold = 10-50 might be reasonable\n")
  cat("- If using CPM: count_threshold = 0.5-1 is standard\n")
  cat("- Gene sample threshold: 10 is reasonable (present in", 
      round(10/nrow(counts)*100, 1), "% of samples)\n")
  cat("===========================================\n\n")
  
  return(combined)
}

# Generate diagnostics for each hormone dataset
diag_TT <- create_pseudobulk_diagnostics(notype_pb_TT, "Testosterone", "TT")
diag_E2 <- create_pseudobulk_diagnostics(notypepb_E2, "Estradiol", "E2")
diag_P4 <- create_pseudobulk_diagnostics(notypepb_P4, "Progesterone", "P4")
```

# Differential Gene Expression Analysis

## Define Functions
### DE analysis wrapper functions
```{r limma analysis}
run_voom_lm_cc <- function(counts, metadata, predictor) {
  stopifnot(ncol(counts) == nrow(metadata))

  # Safely quote variables for formula
  safe_vars <- function(x) {
    ifelse(make.names(x) != x, paste0("`", x, "`"), x)
  }

  # Build model matrix
  formula_vars <- safe_vars(c(predictor, "cell_count"))
  design <- model.matrix(reformulate(formula_vars), data = metadata)

  # Fit voom-limma model
  v <- limma::voom(counts, design)
  fit <- limma::lmFit(v, design)
  fit <- limma::eBayes(fit)

  # Figure out correct coefficient name or index
  predictor_col <- colnames(design)[2]  # assumes predictor is 1st after intercept
  limma::topTable(fit, coef = predictor_col, number = Inf, sort.by = "none") %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene")
}

run_voom_lm_cc_gw <- function(counts, metadata, predictor) {
  stopifnot(ncol(counts) == nrow(metadata))
  if (!"GW" %in% colnames(metadata)) metadata$GW <- NA

  # Safely quote variables for formula
  safe_vars <- function(x) {
    ifelse(make.names(x) != x, paste0("`", x, "`"), x)
  }

  # Build model matrix
  formula_vars <- safe_vars(c(predictor, "cell_count", "GW"))
  design <- model.matrix(reformulate(formula_vars), data = metadata)

  # Fit voom-limma model
  v <- limma::voom(counts, design)
  fit <- limma::lmFit(v, design)
  fit <- limma::eBayes(fit)

  # Figure out correct coefficient name or index
  predictor_col <- colnames(design)[2]  # assumes predictor is 1st after intercept
  limma::topTable(fit, coef = predictor_col, number = Inf, sort.by = "none") %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene")
}

run_voom_lm <- function(counts, metadata, predictor) {
  stopifnot(ncol(counts) == nrow(metadata))

  # Safely quote variables for formula
  safe_vars <- function(x) {
    ifelse(make.names(x) != x, paste0("`", x, "`"), x)
  }

  # Build model matrix
  formula_vars <- safe_vars(c(predictor))
  design <- model.matrix(reformulate(formula_vars), data = metadata)

  # Fit voom-limma model
  v <- limma::voom(counts, design)
  fit <- limma::lmFit(v, design)
  fit <- limma::eBayes(fit)

  # Figure out correct coefficient name or index
  predictor_col <- colnames(design)[2]  # assumes predictor is 1st after intercept
  limma::topTable(fit, coef = predictor_col, number = Inf, sort.by = "none") %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene")
}

```


### Filtering Function
```{r filtering functions}
# analyze_hormone_notype: Analyze hormone-gene relationships without cell type stratification
#
# Parameters:
#   count_threshold: Expression threshold for gene filtering
#   gene_sample_threshold: Minimum number of samples where gene must meet threshold
#   use_cpm: If TRUE, apply threshold to CPM values; if FALSE, use raw counts
#            Set based on diagnostic plots - use CPM if cell counts vary widely
#
analyze_hormone_notype <- function(pb_counts, metadata_merged, hormone, 
                                   overall_min_samples = 8, 
                                   count_threshold = 1, 
                                   gene_sample_threshold = 10, 
                                   use_cpm = TRUE,
                                   model = run_voom_lm) {

    initial_sample_size <- nrow(metadata_merged)
    cat("\nGroup:", "bulk", "\n")
    cat("Initial number of samples:", initial_sample_size, "\n")
    
    #transpose counts to genes x samples (required for limma)
    pb_counts = t(pb_counts)
    
    # Gene-level filtering based on expression
    if (use_cpm) {
      # CPM-based filtering: accounts for library size differences
      # Recommended when cell counts per sample vary widely
      cat("Using CPM-based filtering with threshold:", count_threshold, "\n")
      filter_values <- edgeR::cpm(pb_counts, log = FALSE)
      filter_label <- "CPM"
    } else {
      # Raw count filtering: simpler, appropriate when cell counts are similar
      cat("Using raw count filtering with threshold:", count_threshold, "\n")
      filter_values <- pb_counts
      filter_label <- "raw counts"
    }
    
    # Keep genes with expression > threshold in at least min_samples
    keep_genes <- rowSums(filter_values >= count_threshold) >= gene_sample_threshold
    
    # Subset to keep only genes that pass the threshold (subset rows)
    pb_counts <- pb_counts[keep_genes, , drop = FALSE]
    
    cat("Genes passing", filter_label, "filter:", sum(keep_genes), "out of", length(keep_genes), "\n")
    cat("Filter criteria:", filter_label, ">=", count_threshold, "in >=", gene_sample_threshold, "samples\n")

    # Check if any genes remain after filtering
    # CORRECT - genes are rows after transpose
  if (nrow(pb_counts) == 0) {
      cat("Group removed: no genes passed the filtering threshold\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Mask for non-zero and non-NA hormone values
    nonzero_hormone_mask <- metadata_merged[[hormone]] != 0 & !is.na(metadata_merged[[hormone]])
    cat("Samples with non-zero hormone:", sum(nonzero_hormone_mask), "\n")
    
    # Check if enough samples have non-zero hormone values
    if (sum(nonzero_hormone_mask) < overall_min_samples) {
      cat("Group removed: insufficient non-zero hormone values", sum(nonzero_hormone_mask), "\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Subset counts and metadata to only those with non-zero hormone values
  final_counts_sub <- pb_counts[, nonzero_hormone_mask, drop = FALSE]
    final_metadata_sub <- metadata_merged[nonzero_hormone_mask, , drop = FALSE]
    
    cat("Final sample size:", nrow(final_metadata_sub), "\n")
    
    # Run the modeling function
    result <- model(final_counts_sub, final_metadata_sub, hormone)
    
    # Return the result including the filtered data used for modeling
    list(
      limma_results = result,
      pb_counts = final_counts_sub,
      metadata_merged = final_metadata_sub
    )
}
```

### Plotting Function
```{r plotting-function, echo = TRUE, message = FALSE}
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'
plot_top_genes <- function(data, output_dir, hormone, top_n = 6) {
  dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  limma_res <- data$limma_results
  counts_sub <- data$pb_counts  # genes x samples
  metadata_sub <- data$metadata_merged
    
    # Compute log1p(CPM)
    counts_cpm <- edgeR::cpm(counts_sub, log = FALSE)
    counts_log <- log1p(counts_cpm)
    
    # Transpose counts: samples x genes
    counts_log <- t(counts_log)

    top_genes <- limma_res %>%
      filter(adj.P.Val < 0.5) %>%
      arrange(-abs(t)) %>%
      slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
      pull(gene)
    
    top_genes_pvals <- limma_res %>%
        filter(gene %in% top_genes) %>%
        select(gene, adj.P.Val) %>%
        as.data.frame()

    # For notype analysis, cell_type will be "bulk"
    analysis_label <- ifelse("cell_type" %in% colnames(metadata_sub), 
                             metadata_sub$cell_type[1], 
                             "bulk")
    
    message(" Plotting group: ", analysis_label)
    message("- Top genes: ", paste(top_genes, collapse = ", "))

    plot_list <- purrr::map(seq_len(nrow(top_genes_pvals)), function(i) {
      gene <- top_genes_pvals$gene[i]
      adj_pval <- top_genes_pvals$adj.P.Val[i]
      
      if (!gene %in% colnames(counts_log)) {
        message("    Gene ", gene, " not in counts â€” skipping")
        return(NULL)
      }

      expr_vals <- counts_log[, gene]
      if (all(is.na(expr_vals)) || all(expr_vals == 0)) {
        message("    Gene ", gene, " has all NA or zero expression â€” skipping")
        return(NULL)
      }
      
      message("    Plotting gene: ", gene, " (adj. p-value: ", format(adj_pval, digits = 3), ")")
      flush.console()
 
      df <- metadata_sub %>% mutate(expr = expr_vals)

      p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = !!sym(hormone), y = expr)) +
        geom_point(aes(color = cell_count, shape = Sex), size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
        scale_color_viridis_c() +
        scale_shape_manual(values = c("M" = 16, "F" = 17)) +
        labs(title = paste0(gene, " (adj. p-value: ", format(adj_pval, digits = 3), ")"),
             subtitle = paste0("Analysis: ", analysis_label),
             x = hormone, y = "log1p(CPM)") +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
        stat_cor(method = "pearson", label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "top", size = 5)
      #Add in limma p value, label two separate p values (correlation vs limma > adjusted p value)
      p
    }) %>% compact()

    if (length(plot_list) == 0) {
      message("No valid plots for group")
      return()
    }

    combined_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 2)
    clean_name <- gsub("/", "-", analysis_label)

    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(clean_name, "_top_genes.png")),
           plot = combined_plot, width = 10, height = 6 + ceiling(length(plot_list)/2), dpi = 300)
    message("  ✅ Saved plot for ", clean_name)
}  

```

### Summary Functions
```{r summarize}
# Create volcano plot showing logFC vs -log10(adj.P.Val)
create_volcano_plot <- function(results, hormone_name, fdr_threshold = 0.05, logfc_threshold = 0.25) {
  
  # Add significance category
  results_plot <- results %>%
    mutate(
      significance = case_when(
        adj.P.Val < fdr_threshold & abs(logFC) >= logfc_threshold ~ "Significant",
        adj.P.Val < fdr_threshold ~ "FDR < 0.05 only",
        abs(logFC) >= logfc_threshold ~ "LogFC > 0.25 only",
        TRUE ~ "Not significant"
      ),
      neg_log_p = -log10(adj.P.Val)
    )
  
  # Count by category
  sig_counts <- results_plot %>%
    count(significance) %>%
    arrange(desc(n))
  
  # Create volcano plot
  p <- ggplot(results_plot, aes(x = logFC, y = neg_log_p, color = significance)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_threshold), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logfc_threshold, logfc_threshold), linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Significant" = "red",
      "FDR < 0.05 only" = "orange",
      "LogFC > 0.25 only" = "blue",
      "Not significant" = "grey70"
    )) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(hormone_name, " - Volcano Plot"),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Significant: ", sig_counts$n[sig_counts$significance == "Significant"], " genes | ",
        "Total tested: ", nrow(results_plot), " genes"
      ),
      x = "log2 Fold Change",
      y = "-log10(Adjusted P-value)",
      color = "Category"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  return(list(plot = p, counts = sig_counts))
}

# Create p-value distribution and top genes summary
create_pvalue_summary_plot <- function(results, hormone_name) {
  
  # P-value distribution
  p1 <- ggplot(results, aes(x = adj.P.Val)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.1, linetype = "dashed", color = "orange") +
    annotate("text", x = 0.05, y = Inf, label = "FDR=0.05", 
             vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1, color = "red", size = 3) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = Inf, label = "FDR=0.1", 
             vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1, color = "orange", size = 3) +
    labs(
      title = "Distribution of Adjusted P-values",
      x = "Adjusted P-value",
      y = "Number of Genes"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
  
  # Summary statistics
  p_stats <- data.frame(
    Metric = c(
      "Total genes tested",
      "FDR < 0.05",
      "FDR < 0.1",
      "FDR < 0.2",
      "Median adj.P.Val",
      "Mean |logFC|",
      "Max |logFC|"
    ),
    Value = c(
      nrow(results),
      sum(results$adj.P.Val < 0.05),
      sum(results$adj.P.Val < 0.1),
      sum(results$adj.P.Val < 0.2),
      round(median(results$adj.P.Val), 3),
      round(mean(abs(results$logFC)), 3),
      round(max(abs(results$logFC)), 3)
    )
  )
  
  # Top 10 genes by p-value
  top_genes <- results %>%
    arrange(adj.P.Val) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) %>%
    select(gene, logFC, adj.P.Val, t) %>%
    mutate(
      logFC = round(logFC, 3),
      adj.P.Val = format(adj.P.Val, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3),
      t = round(t, 2)
    )
  
  # Create text plot for statistics
  p2 <- ggplot() +
    annotate("table", x = 0.5, y = 0.7, 
             label = list(p_stats), 
             size = 3) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.95, 
             label = paste0(hormone_name, " - Summary Statistics"),
             size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
    theme_void()
  
  # Top genes table
  p3 <- ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.95, 
             label = "Top 10 Genes (by adj.P.Val)",
             size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10))
  
  # Combine
  combined <- (p1 | p2) / p3
  
  return(list(
    plot = combined,
    stats = p_stats,
    top_genes = top_genes
  ))
}

# Create MA plot (mean expression vs logFC)
create_ma_plot <- function(results, hormone_name, fdr_threshold = 0.05) {
  
  # Calculate mean expression (AveExpr from limma)
  results_plot <- results %>%
    mutate(
      significant = adj.P.Val < fdr_threshold,
      neg_log_p = -log10(adj.P.Val)
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(results_plot, aes(x = AveExpr, y = logFC, color = significant)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black", size = 0.3) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("TRUE" = "red", "FALSE" = "grey70"),
      labels = c("TRUE" = paste0("FDR < ", fdr_threshold), "FALSE" = "Not significant")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(hormone_name, " - MA Plot"),
      subtitle = paste0("Significant genes: ", sum(results_plot$significant)),
      x = "Average Expression (log2 CPM)",
      y = "log2 Fold Change",
      color = ""
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  return(p)
}
```
